name: Sketch line
summary: Lines with a small jitter and a double stroke, so that a drawing on a screen looks drawn by hand.
how: Offset each line by 0.5 to 2 px at random points along its length.
Draw each line twice with a small change, as a pencil does.
Fill shapes with hatching at 45 degrees, not with flat colour.

origin.note: Balsamiq Mockups draws wireframes with hand-drawn lines and a comic font, so that they look unfinished.

adoptions.via: Rage comics draw crude faces and stick bodies with a mouse in a basic paint program.
Wojak drawings use uneven mouse lines and flat fills.
Excalidraw and the Rough.js library draw diagrams and interface shapes with a jittered double stroke.
